journey.title: Set up an economy from nothing
journey.purpose: The first-run path a minter takes on an instance with no token type, ending with a holder who can actually earn.

steps.intent: The minter arrives at an empty console and is routed to the one action that unblocks everything else.
The minter learns that nothing works until a type exists, and what a supply policy will permanently constrain.
The minter names the economy, gives it a symbol and colour, and chooses its supply policy.
The minter adds a holder and binds them to a real authenticated identity rather than a role flag.
The minter describes what the tokens should buy, in the household's own vocabulary.
The minter chooses deliberately which rewards settle instantly and which wait for approval.
The minter issues a first grant with a reason that will reach the holder's history.
The console now shows a working economy with a holder, a balance, and a catalog.

claims.statement: Every empty state in the setup path routes to the action that unblocks it rather than presenting a blank surface.
